## Deck Goal
面向公司领导与同事，用12页高管汇报解释Data Watch的建设背景、平台架构、四项创新、落地成效和下一步路线。

{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Data Watch是面向自动化码头的工业设备数据采集与监控平台。它把S7、GE SRTP、OPC UA、OPC DA等现场数据转换为统一数据流，支持中心式和分布式边缘部署，通过Redis承载实时态、TDengine保存时序历史、MySQL保存配置与权限，并通过Web、桌面App和CLI向业务用户、运维人员、脚本及AI Agent提供受控访问。",
    "core_claim": "先让分散的设备数据完整、持续、可信地流动，才可能实现真正的人机协同与智能运维。",
    "canonical_terms": [
      "Data Watch",
      "Collector",
      "Edge Storage",
      "SQLite outbox",
      "Uploader",
      "Ingest",
      "Redis",
      "Writer",
      "TDengine",
      "MySQL",
      "Backend",
      "Web",
      "App",
      "CLI",
      "AI Agent",
      "Good / Uncertain / Bad"
    ],
    "content_principle": "视觉优先，不把讲稿搬上页面。每页以一个图表、路径、架构、矩阵或核心隐喻承载逻辑，文字只做短标签和结论。不得虚构数据。"
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "Redis承担实时latest/window/stream/DLQ；Writer消费Stream并写TDengine；MySQL保存配置、权限、拓扑；CLI只经Backend访问。"
  }
}

Use Image 1 as the approved sample-slide style reference. Match its palette, typography mood, density, texture, and overall visual identity. Do not copy its exact layout unless this slide's layout explicitly asks for it.

- Render Chinese text exactly and legibly; avoid garbled characters.
